notes:
First native release of LacTracker for macOS and Windows: one program with one main screen. It replaces the web app; no Python, browser or local server needed.

- Setup, device, live chart, markers and review all on one screen
- Measurement settings for firmware v0.3.0+, with automatic reconnect after the device restarts
- Supports firmware v0.4 (ring log)
- Sessions saved as sensor-json files; Export to _data as before
- Reminds you when a newer version is published
